channel.title: The Hyperscaler Index · compute.world
channel.description: General-purpose clouds that also rent GPUs. GPU-only specialists are Neoclouds. Scaleway and OVH are regional hyperscalers — full IaaS, not a neocloud. China and the EU stay visible even when a city is undisclosed. Snapshot 2026-08-19. 17 providers. Not a market cap.

item.title: Amazon Web Services · hyperscaler
item.description: Amazon Web Services (hyperscaler). HQ Seattle · United States. 38 sourced location rows. Cities: 25 named · 5 state/region only · 8 undisclosed. H100, H200, B200, A100, Trainium, Inferentia. Official commercial table fetched 2026-08-19. Marketing: 39 geographic regions / 123–124 AZs. GPU availability is a subset (P/G/Trn/Inf). China and GovCloud are separate accounts. No fake market cap.

item.title: Microsoft Azure · hyperscaler
item.description: Microsoft Azure (hyperscaler). HQ Redmond · United States. 66 sourced location rows. Cities: 25 named · 39 state/region only. H100, H200, A100, ND/NC-series GPUs. Footnote on official geographies page (fetched 2026-08-19) lists regions available or coming soon. Do not treat every row as GA GPU. China is operated with 21Vianet. No market cap.

item.title: Google Cloud · hyperscaler
item.description: Google Cloud (hyperscaler). HQ Mountain View · United States. 43 sourced location rows. Cities: 43 named. A4X Max GB300, A4X GB200, A4 B200, A3 H200/H100, A2 A100, G4 RTX PRO 6000. Locations page (updated 2026-08-17): 43 regions / 130 zones. Region list here is from the official Compute Engine regions-and-zones table. Specialized AI zones exist as extra zone names.

item.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure · hyperscaler
item.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (hyperscaler). HQ Austin · United States. 45 sourced location rows. Cities: 43 named. H100, H200, B200, GB200 — BM.GPU families. Full official commercial-realm region table. Government/sovereign realms omitted (separate docs). Strong GPU IaaS.

item.title: IBM Cloud · hyperscaler
item.description: IBM Cloud (hyperscaler). HQ Armonk · United States. 13 sourced location rows. Cities: 13 named. GPU VMs / bare metal — confirm catalog; not a neocloud-scale H100 shop. Official Kubernetes/VPC MZR table. Classic DCs are additional. Public GPU cloud exists but is not the category leader.

item.title: Huawei Cloud · hyperscaler

item.title: Scaleway · regional hyperscaler
item.description: Scaleway (regional hyperscaler). HQ Paris · France. 4 sourced location rows. Cities: 4 named. H100, L4, L40S and other GPU instances — confirm GPU product page. CLASSIFICATION: regional-hyperscaler, not neocloud. Reason: full IaaS catalog (compute, storage, network, managed DBs, Kubernetes) plus GPU and Generative APIs. GPU-only buyers still find it; the index home is Hyperscalers. Token APIs dual-listed under Inference.
